## Checklist

- [ ] Tests added or updated (`xcodebuild test …` and `python3 -m unittest discover tests` pass)
- [ ] No new dependencies, or discussed in an issue first
- [ ] Nothing networked on by default; any new address is in `tests/network_allowlist.txt`
- [ ] New interface text has a Russian translation in `Localizable.xcstrings`
- [ ] Screenshots, if any, show the island only and nothing personal
